original The supplied recognition certificate and an official historical Startup India list identify the company as a recognised startup. Recognition is distinct from a tax-exemption certificate, healthcare approval or an award. Current eligibility and status should be read from the updated certificate and applicable rules. Original source: COR_DIPP8651.pdf, p1; Startup India list dated 3 November 2023, row 3630.
